color.note: Soft neutral. White and #121212 like the system itself; near-black / near-white ink is the brand; colour only where it means something. Every screen, the lock screen too, follows the Appearance setting (System default, Light or Dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one filled action per screen, the switch's on track, the PIN dots, selected segments and chips. Near-black in light, near-white in dark.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Pressed PIN keys, the highlighted row, the summary sentence panel.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text on primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary icons.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on secondary fills (rare).

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Unselected segment and chip fill on press; the PIN key at rest in dark.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text on secondary-container.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Every screen's window background, the lock screen included: pure white in light, Android's #121212 in dark, so Krypt blends with the system and other apps.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Top bars, lists, sheets.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Grouped list sections (onboarding checklist, the request card).

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Search field.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet, dialog.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Titles and body on background, surface and every surface-container.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, eyebrows, package names, hints, on background, surface and every surface-container.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive things: secondary buttons, fields, chips, the off switch. 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar and toast.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Snackbar action text.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and icons, on background and surface.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on error fills.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: The error panel on the Guardian screen.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text on error-container.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2dp focus ring drawn 2dp outside the control.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: locked
tokens.usage: Status: protected. Locked status text and icon. The brand ink: protection looks like the rest of the app.

tokens.name: locked-container
tokens.usage: Status: protected. Count badge behind 'Locked'.

tokens.name: on-locked-container
tokens.usage: Text on locked-container.

tokens.name: open
tokens.usage: Status: unlocked for now / daily time left. Text and icon, on surface.

tokens.name: open-container
tokens.usage: Count badge behind 'Open now'.

tokens.name: on-open-container
tokens.usage: Text on open-container.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Status: time's up / paused. Text and icon, on surface; the lock screen's reason icon.

tokens.name: caution-container
tokens.usage: The daily-time note on the Guardian screen.

tokens.name: on-caution-container
tokens.usage: Text on caution-container.

tokens.name: granted
tokens.usage: The granted check and word in onboarding, on surface-container-low.

tokens.name: flash
tokens.usage: Approval confirmation only: the soft mint field behind the check. Never under text, never for status.

tokens.name: on-flash
tokens.usage: The check mark drawn on flash.

styles.name: display-large
styles.usage: The one statement on a full screen: 'Locked.', 'Approved.'. Serif, never bold.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: Screen titles: 'Welcome to Krypt', 'Krypt Admin', 'Access request'.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Sheet and dialog titles; the Guardian summary sentence.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Top bar title; section titles inside long screens.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: App names in rows; checklist item titles.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Your Guardian approves from their own phone. Nothing leaves this one except the link you send.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Status lines, supporting text, inline errors.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The small all-caps line above a title (write the text in capitals in strings.xml).

styles.name: mono-countdown
styles.usage: The lockout countdown inside its ring.

spacing.note: 4dp grid, generous. Screen gutter is space-5 (20dp).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a status line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; between eyebrow and title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside rows: icon to text; between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter at every width.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a title block and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top inset above a screen's eyebrow.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Breathing room above the bottom action area on full screens.

radius.note: Soft, not round: controls 14, cards 22. Only dots, switches and badges are fully round.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: App icons in rows, PIN keys, chips, badges' inner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, snackbar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped sections, the lock-screen app tile.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: PIN dots, switch, count badges, timeline dots.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum target for every control.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in status lines and badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Top-bar actions; the reason icon.

tokens.name: app-icon-row
tokens.usage: App icon in a list row.

tokens.name: app-icon-tile
tokens.usage: App icon on the lock screen and the request card.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: button-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small actions inside grouped cards, such as Allow in settings on an onboarding row. Never inside Home app rows.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Text fields and search.

tokens.name: key-height
tokens.usage: PIN keypad key.

tokens.name: pin-dot
tokens.usage: A PIN dot.

tokens.name: column-max
tokens.usage: Max content width on full screens.

tokens.name: screen-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest supported width; must fit at 200% font scale.

shadow.note: No shadows on surfaces; hierarchy comes from hairlines and space.

tokens.name: elevation-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the snackbar only.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: State layer on hover.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: State layer on press.

tokens.name: disabled-content
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons.

tokens.name: disabled-container
tokens.usage: Disabled button fill.

duration.note: Quiet motion. With animations removed: all 0 except the flash, shown static for 500ms.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Key press, segment selection, switch.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Revealing a custom field; status changes; sheet content.

tokens.name: motion-indicator
tokens.usage: Granted / not-granted change in onboarding (spec: 200-500ms).

tokens.name: motion-flash
tokens.usage: Approval confirmation (spec: at least 500ms).

tokens.name: motion-easing
tokens.usage: Every transition.

meta.note: A new design to docs/UI-DESIGN-BRIEF.md. Nothing visual is taken from the test UI; only the brief's fixed rules carry over. Fonts from google/fonts (OFL); icons from google/material-design-icons (Apache 2.0).
